scientific_status: geometric conversion and published pipeline behavior established; absolute source coefficient, ePSF normalization and color mapping not validated for the WISE fit

verified.tractor_conversion: Tractor flux amplitude in MJy/sr multiplied by nearest-source SAPM; oversample=1 in forced photometry; output uJy
verified.gain_application: R6 calibration subtracts dark then multiplies by gain, and converts variance unit by gain squared; IMAGE is already calibrated.
verified.tractor_native_patch: R6 PSF path shifts and area-downsamples oversampled PSF then divides by native patch sum.
verified.epsf_irsa_example: IRSA ePSF tutorial code evaluates ImagePSF at native pixel centers and normalizes the rendered stamp. Its prose describes shift/downsample/integrate; the example does not explicitly integrate a second pixel window.
verified.raw_local_epsf: QR3 D6 ePSF, OVSMPX=5, image dimensions 33x33, DETCOORD=sky; local motion candidate applies over^2 / raw sum before interpolation and does not separately normalize each native stamp.

conditional_formulae.assumptions: p_i is an already validated native-pixel source fraction, sum(p_i)=1 over declared full unmasked support, and F is the appropriate bandpass flux density; source position and response are fixed.
conditional_formulae.warning: Different assumptions; neither constitutes a validated WISE physical model. Do not normalize only selected/masked pixels. Native ePSF support, PSF tails, spatially varying bandpass and source-color convention remain unverified.

sapm_header_observation.hash_note: Only downloaded byte range, not a full-file SHA-256.
sapm_header_observation.limitation: IRSA tutorial example product only; no proof this SAPM version matches each of the 31 WISE exposures. Their HDU HISTORY contains no SAPM UUID. Validate each HDU and coordinate mapping; R7 channel map is sky-oriented whereas R7 BC/BW HDUs are DEVICE-oriented.

spectral_convention.supplement: QR2 absolute calibration described using 11 CALSPEC stars, integrated source spectra and zodiacal color correction.
spectral_convention.public_code: Discrete sum(trans*spectrum)/sum(trans); zodi/star normalized bandpass ratio in update_photometric_calibration.
remaining_unknowns: Precise trans definition, sampling grid and photon versus energy weighting in external SPinst.Tabular_Bandpass
